tech.summary: Anthropic said new measures to stop rivals copying Claude's capabilities have cut data harvested in "distillation attacks" by 90-99%, with reasoning tokens extracted now 10-100x lower. It banned tens of thousands of accounts linked to distillation campaigns and named Chinese startup Z.ai as an example; the company claims its extraction-defense system is as robust as safeguards against bioweapon assistance, with under 0.1% false positives.
tech.title: Anthropic says new safeguards cut AI model-distillation attacks up to 99%

tech.summary: Japanese manufacturer Omron will acquire US industrial PC firm Onlogic and its parent Interlogic for $675 million to build "physical AI" services inside its industrial automation business, combining its precision-control tech with Onlogic hardware and expanding its US customer base. Onlogic will keep operating independently under its own brand and management.
tech.title: Japan's Omron to buy US industrial PC maker Onlogic for $675M in physical-AI push

tech.summary: Startups like FutureSearch, Preseen and Mantic claim AI forecasting models already match elite human "superforecasters", citing two AI models taking top spots in the Metaculus Cup in September. One founder says he turned $35 into $1.9M in seven months using AI tools on prediction site Kalshi, with hedge funds the quickest buyers of such forecasts.
tech.title: AI forecasting startups bet they can out-predict human experts

tech.summary: Elon Musk's xAI limited Grok's image generation and editing to paying subscribers after backlash over tools used to create sexualized deepfakes of women and children. Downing Street called the move "insulting" and "not a solution", the EU said its fundamental concerns remain, and the European Commission ordered X to retain all internal documents on Grok until end-2026.
tech.title: Grok restricts AI image editing to paid users after sexualized-deepfake backlash

tech.summary: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress told the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference that the company's potential $100B investment agreement with OpenAI, outlined in a September letter of intent covering at least 10 GW of systems, has not been finalized. Separately, its planned $10B investment in Anthropic could also lift its $500B advanced-chip order backlog.
tech.title: Nvidia CFO: $100B OpenAI agreement still unsettled

tech.summary: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva warned this week that AI is reducing demand for routine, repetitive work, describing it as a "slow-moving tsunami" for jobs. Australian legal-AI firm Quillio's COO forecasts a 2027 hiring downturn but argues AI equips more workers to start their own businesses, while Australia's assistant minister warned AI providers could become "toll collectors" for the economy.
tech.title: IMF warns of AI 'slow-moving tsunami' for jobs; some say workers will just hire themselves

pakistan.summary: The federal government imposed emergency and governor's rule in KP on Oct 11, with President Zardari signing the summary on PM Shehbaz's advice under Articles 232 and 234, transferring the CM's powers to Governor Kundi. The cabinet cited the PTI-led provincial government's "deliberate disengagement from the fight against terrorism" amid a long march demanding Imran Khan's release; PTI rejects the move as unconstitutional.
pakistan.title: 'No lesson learnt': emergency and governor's rule imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

pakistan.summary: Security forces killed 12 Fitna al-Khawarij and Afghan Taliban personnel while foiling an infiltration attempt from Afghanistan into Kurram district, ISPR said on Oct 11. Naib Subedar Hidayat Aman, 40, embraced martyrdom in the exchange of fire; ISPR accused Afghan Taliban posts of opening fire to support the infiltration.
pakistan.title: One soldier martyred, 12 terrorists killed as forces foil Kurram infiltration attempt

pakistan.summary: Deputy PM and FM Ishaq Dar strongly condemned the Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, which killed 12 people and injured 309, including six Pakistani nationals. He reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment to Saudi Arabia's sovereignty under the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement and directed the Pakistani embassy in Riyadh to assist the injured Pakistanis.
pakistan.title: FM Dar condemns Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says Pakistan in touch with Saudi authorities

pakistan.summary: Punjab CM Maryam Nawaz approved a Rs10 billion subsidy to hold down flour prices and increased subsidised government wheat quota to flour mills at Rs3,800 per maund after an emergency video-link meeting. The move follows reports of wheat hitting Rs5,200 per 40kg in Punjab and a 20kg flour bag reaching Rs3,400 in Karachi, Islamabad and Peshawar.
pakistan.title: Punjab approves Rs10bn flour subsidy as wheat prices surge

pakistan.summary: South African jurist Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts to promote peace and international law; hours later the Trump administration sanctioned the ICC, a court she once served. Shortly before the announcement, PM Shehbaz Sharif had renewed Pakistan's backing of Trump's nomination, crediting him with helping end last year's India-Pakistan escalation.
pakistan.title: Navi Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize; Pakistan had backed Trump's bid
